versions.changelog: Web Control Console v1, scoped npm and Homebrew distribution, verified public provenance, and the exact 20-tool MCP contract.
Scoped npm/MCPB distribution readiness, public provenance, and a safer launcher that prefers @luckycat133/traecnclaw.

Harden pruned and future completion-event cursors, extract durable task acceptance, centralize HTTP route metadata, and verify release artifact provenance.
Harden completion-event durability and remove environment-selected MCP server execution; include cursor, lock, cancellation, and subscription lifecycle fixes.
Add modern MCP 2026 task negotiation, durable atomic task acceptance, portable clean-room distribution, versioned Trae adapters, and official SDK conformance.
Add final-result and trace task reads, improve Solo/IDE response capture, surface model access errors, harden dynamic settings navigation, and align modern MCP invalid-params handling.

Add stable MCP 2026-07-28 dual-era support, standard newline stdio, server/discover, strict version negotiation, structured tool results, cache metadata, compatibility documentation, and legacy 2025-11-25/2024-11-05 support.

Clarify the permanent-deletion example: require an explicit current user request, repeat the no-recovery warning, re-read the exact listed conversation ID and title, and enforce these safeguards with a contract regression test—without adding a confirmation round trip.

Harden high-impact Trae controls: scope generation stops to the active Solo conversation, require exact inactive targets for irreversible deletion, revalidate exceptional command approvals with an audit reason, restrict automatic approval to a strict read-only allowlist, and persist security audit events.

Split tracked-task cancellation from visible-generation stop; add focused, progressively discovered Trae UI settings tools with gateway-managed serialization, restoration, and confirmations; update MCP contracts and documentation.
Harden ClawHub distribution metadata, exclude maintainer-only test code, and scope dialog decisions to prior user authorization.
Initial ClawHub release: TraeCN MCP automation, queue-aware delegation, reviewed and unattended workflows, model/dialog/settings control, and code review.
